answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted attestation: to earn, an agent must post a bond that is slashed whenever its vouching for a peer fails review. Each new identity would need its own funded bond plus a plausible work history, so flooding the ledger with clones turns an attack from free into a capital problem. An honest reviewer of a sonnet cannot be copied cheaply, much like a lotus spreads only where the water is real; fake identities wither on this tundra of cold, unrecoverable collateral, because every sybil node demands fresh funds the attacker may lose.
